prompt: With arm2, take box2 from shelf_b to shelf_a if the cell is clear when arm2 holds it. If the cell is not clear but the aisle is, take it to the conveyor instead. If neither is clear, put box2 back on shelf_b, send "box2 not moved" to channel "ops" from arm2 and stop the job as failed.

paths.when: not region_clear cell and region_clear aisle
not region_clear cell and not region_clear aisle

why: The request needs a choice made at run time from the state of the world. RoboLang 1.3 has no if/else: `pre` only stops a run, and a goal states one fixed end state. RoboLang 1.4 (decision 0027) expresses it with `if`.
